tests/controlMatrixChromeReliability.tes.reason: Chrome reliability scenarios share the relay and browser-host fixture, including reconnect and ownership transitions.

tests/controlMatrixHealth.test.ts.reason: Control-health scenarios share the host, helper and recovery fixture. Permission and readiness outcomes are exercised through the common control boundary.

tests/controlMatrixPageEdges.test.ts.reason: Page-edge scenarios share fake tabs and the browser host. Keep crash, failed-load and recovery outcomes in that common environment.

tests/controlMatrixStop.test.ts.reason: Stop scenarios share pending actions, ownership tokens and the control fixture. Keep cancellation and late-completion cases in one matrix.

tests/controlMatrixTokens.test.ts.reason: Turn-token scenarios share the control fixture and its adapters. Token retirement and late commands must be compared across the same owners.

tests/titleBarUI.test.ts.reason: Title-bar and browser-tab interactions share a mounted header, store and native bridge. Motion and failure cases use that same fixture.
